## Invalid option values

<!-- These declarations are valid YAML but invalid under Tractate's option contract. -->

```{r}
#| label: ""
#| eval: "false"
#| echo: yes
#| include: 1
#| results: asis
#| session: ""
#| cache: auto
#| inputs: data/observations.csv
#| fig-width: 0
#| fig-height: -1
#| fig-cap: [First, Second]

plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: "two words"
#| eval: null
#| echo: [1, 2]
#| include: {}

#| session: false
#| cache: "true"
#| inputs: [data/observations.csv, 42, "", null]
#| fig-width: .inf
#| fig-height: .nan
#| fig-cap: false

plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: null

plot(1:3)
```
